Senses.Explanation: To burn incense and bow is a public monastic act of reverence, ordered in hall routines and conspicuous when a visitor omits it. The rules place the paired actions before images and scriptures. Dahui retells Yongjia’s arrival as striking precisely because he circles the seat without first performing them; Shitian lists them among outward occupations when pressing hearers to turn back to their own work.
